DJI launches Dock 4 with 25-second automatic battery swaps

The Matrice 5TD pairing targets shorter gaps between emergency-response and inspection flights.

DJI / RoboticsTomorrow ↗14 October 2026English editorial summary
Story

Less turnaround between missions

DJI launched Dock 4 with the Matrice 5TD, claiming a 25-second automatic battery swap instead of an approximately 30-minute recharge. The drone’s stated maximum endurance is 59 minutes, targeting response teams and scheduled inspections.

Multiple sensing systems

Matrice 5TD combines telephoto, infrared and night imaging with laser ranging. Three-direction mmWave radar, rotating LiDAR and six-direction vision support obstacle detection. An O4 Ground Station can improve communications around obstructions.

Performance has conditions

DJI specifies a −40°C to 50°C operating range for Dock 4 and sales through Enterprise dealers. Performance figures come from controlled testing; some features depend on paired equipment and region, requiring deployment-specific checks.
